sentences.text:
Ram Kumar Dey vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 15 May,
2024
Author: Suvra Ghosh

Ram Kumar Dey
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & ors.
 Adv. Indradeep Pal,
 ...for the petitioner.
 Adv. Chandi Charan De,
 Adv. Anirban Sarkar,
 ...for the State.
Heard learned counsels for the parties.

Learned counsel for the State, in his usual fairness,
 submits that since the plot in dispute is governed by the West Bengal Highways Act, 1964, the notice issued upon  the petitioner under Section 4(1) of the West Bengal Public  Land (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act, 1962 is  required to be withdrawn.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the notice dated 25 th May, 2023 issued  upon the petitioner under Section 4(1) of the West Bengal  Public Land (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act,
 1962 is treated as withdrawn.

It appears from the report in the form of affidavit  submitted by the requiring body that the award has been  declared in respect of the petitioner's plot no. 169 with an Ram Kumar Dey vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53563255/
1  endorsement "RB applied to release the structure".

sentences.text: It is not  understood as to how only the structure on the plot in  question is proposed to be released by the requiring body.
Also, the report is silent with regard to the  acquisition/compensation in respect of plot no. 168 of  which the petitioner claims to be the owner.
2  The 4th respondent is directed to submit a report in the form of affidavit clarifying the situation.
On prayer of the petitioner, liberty is granted to use an exception to the report, if required.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 26th June, 2024.
